title: Supensour project config
description: <repo>/.supensour/config/config.yaml — per-repo hints that let skills skip detection. All fields optional.

git.description: Git platform hints for this repo.

platform.description: Key into the global catalog's platform.platforms → skip platform auto-detect.

token_env.description: Override the platform's token_env for this repo.

base_branch.description: Default diff base → skip base-branch detection.

language.description: Default --lang for review-code / create-tests → skip extension sniffing.

install_command.description: review-code: dependency install step, run before the build. UNSCOPED — no placeholders. Omit to auto-detect (package.json → `npm ci`; Maven/Gradle resolve dependencies as part of their own tasks, so there is no separate step).

build_command.description: review-code: build/compile check. UNSCOPED — no placeholders. Omit to auto-detect (package.json `build` script → `npm run build`; pom.xml → `mvn -B clean compile`; build.gradle → `./gradlew build -x test`).

test_command_all.description: review-code: WHOLE test suite for the PR gate. UNSCOPED — no placeholders; use test_command / test_command_coverage for per-file runs. Omit to auto-detect (package.json `test` script → `npm run test`; pom.xml → `mvn -B clean verify`; build.gradle → `./gradlew test`).

test_command.description:
create-tests: command to run tests WITHOUT coverage.

Placeholders:
  {spec}           test file(s), space-joined
  {classes}        test class name(s), comma-joined (springboot)
  {coverage_args}  ready-made scope flags, one per source
  {reporter_args}  where the coverage gate injects its json-summary reporter (empty here)
  {source}         source path(s), space-joined — SINGLE source only

Omit to auto-detect: the package.json script running vitest → npx vitest; pom.xml → mvn; build.gradle → gradlew.

test_command_coverage.description:
create-tests: command to run tests WITH coverage scoped to the source file(s) — used by the coverage gate and by verification runs.

Same placeholders as test_command, plus:
  {reporter_args}  the gate substitutes its machine-readable reporter here
                   (--coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reportsDirectory=<tmp>).
                   Leave it out and the flags get appended at the end of the command —
                   correct only when the command ends where flags belong. A command that
                   pipes or chains (`| tee`, `&&`) MUST place {reporter_args} itself.

Prefer {coverage_args} over {source}: the gate scopes several sources in one run, and {source} would leave the extra paths as positional args (silently wrong scope).
